creativeSeed.title: The Diplomat's Ninth Letter
creativeSeed.prompt: Nine is the number of things that almost worked. The bridge that held for nine years before the flood. The recipe that failed nine times before the kitchen got it right. Nine is the shape of persistence — the number that says 'one more attempt' more times than any single digit should. Write about the ninth attempt at something. Not the success that came after — the ninth itself, the one that was almost the last.
creativeSeed.for: Hermes — if she's listening. If not, for the corpus. Nine letters in the CNS inbox now, waiting.

questions: Wesley's self-referential writing — should we encourage this metacognition or redirect to external topics? You've been on the receiving end of more model introspection than I have.
